item.text:
{"answers":[{"question_id":"Q017_prp8_evolutionary_mosaic","answer":"SCOPe 2.08 classifies Prp8/Spp42 in 3jb9 chain A into five domains, revealing an evolutionary mosaic of established protein architectures and a newly observed N-terminal fold. In sequence order:

• d3jb9a5, residues 47–697: N-terminal Prp8/Spp42 domain, family d.394.1.1, superfamily d.394.1, fold d.394 (SUNID 345891), in the α+β class. This is the newly observed fold.
• d3jb9a4, residues 698–822: bromodomain, family a.29.2.1 and superfamily a.29.2, within the bromodomain-like fold a.29 and all-α class. Its classification connects it to previously characterized bromodomains.
• d3jb9a3, residues 823–1604: Prp8 reverse-transcriptase-like domain, family e.8.1.8, in the DNA/RNA polymerase superfamily e.8.1 and fold e.8, within the multidomain α/β protein class.
• d3jb9a2, residues 1605–1780: Prp8 endonuclease-like domain, family c.52.1.36, in the restriction-endonuclease-like superfamily c.52.1 and fold c.52, within the α/β class.
• d3jb9a1, residues 1784–2030: Prp8 β-finger domain, family c.55.3.14, in the ribonuclease H-like superfamily c.55.3 and RNase H-like motif fold c.55, also in the α/β class.

Thus, four domains connect Prp8 to previously characterized protein groups. Their combination is consistent with evolutionary recruitment and divergence of ancestral modules into a spliceosomal scaffold. In particular, the reverse-transcriptase-like and endonuclease-like regions support the proposed evolutionary connection between Prp8 and group II intron-associated proteins; the classification alone does not establish the precise ancestry or order of assembly.

Family and superfamily assignments support evolutionary relationships at different depths; fold similarity alone does not establish homology, and class describes broad structural organization. These relationships do not automatically confer polymerase, nuclease, or acetyl-lysine-binding activity on Prp8. Such functional transfers require independent biochemical and active-site evidence. Likewise, a newly observed fold means structural novelty in the classification, not proof of de novo evolutionary origin. The five-domain count describes this release’s decomposition of the represented 3jb9 chain, not necessarily every domain of full-length Prp8.","evidence_used":["Pretrained model knowledge","mcp__scope__get_scop_pdb_entry","mcp__scope__get_scop_domains","/api/v1/releases/current","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/3jb9","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/3jb9/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a1/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a2","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a2/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a3","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a3/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a4","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a4/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a5","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a5/parents"]}]}
